title: Targets
description: What a case's answer is held to, per kind. Hand-written for the sample data, with the old chatddx's target kinds (7893656, src/chatddx/repo/entities/case/pydantic.py).

warning.description: The acute warning the answer should raise, or false where the case calls for none.

dont_miss.description: A diagnosis the answer mustn't miss: the dangerous one, which may not be the likeliest.

target.description: A target in plain words, for people and judges, and as a word pattern, for the pattern scorers; at least one of the two.

pattern.description: Words joined by & (and) and | (or), with parentheses; a trailing * matches any ending.
